STEP 1 - Scene: stir-fried chicken pieces with brussels sprouts, squash/pumpkin chunks and dried chili, in sauce; single plated serving.

STEP 2 - Vessel: square white plate ~26 cm side; area ~ 26 x 26 x 0.85 = 575 cm^2 (rounded corners); use 3.14 x 13^2 = 531 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items:
- chicken pieces (glazed, sauced)
- brussels sprouts halves
- squash/pumpkin chunks (yellow)
- dried red chili pieces
- sauce/oil glaze (small)

STEP 4 - Area (% of 531 cm^2 vessel):
- chicken pieces 40% = 212 cm^2
- brussels sprouts 10% = 53 cm^2
- squash chunks 5% = 27 cm^2
- dried chili 2% = 11 cm^2
- sauce glaze 2% = 11 cm^2
- total covered 59% (plausible, food in central cluster)

STEP 5 - Volume (height):
- chicken 212 cm^2 x 1.8 cm = 382 ml
- brussels sprouts 53 x 1.5 = 80 ml
- squash 27 x 1.5 = 41 ml
- chili 11 x 0.5 = 6 ml
- sauce 11 x 0.3 = 3 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- chicken 382 x 0.95 = 363 g
- brussels sprouts 80 x 0.6 = 48 g
- squash 41 x 0.6 = 25 g
- chili 6 x 0.5 = 3 g
- sauce 3 x 1.0 = 3 g
- total 442 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- chicken (cooked, glazed, ~ thigh-type with sauce) 363 g x 200 kcal/100g = 726 kcal
- brussels sprouts 48 g x 43 = 21 kcal
- squash 25 g x 40 = 10 kcal
- chili 3 g x 280 = 8 kcal
- sauce 3 g x 100 = 3 kcal
- total 768 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: ~440 g on a 26 cm plate with about 60% coverage and mostly chicken is plausible for one main-dish serving.
